title: Creality 4.2.x (STM32F103, stock bootloader)
description: Creality v4.2.2 / 4.2.7 style boards (Ender-3 V2, Ender-3 S1 older, CR-10 variants): STM32F103, 28 KiB stock bootloader offset, 8 MHz crystal, serial on USART1 PA10/PA9 at 250000 baud, flashed from an SD card.
dda_note: STM32F103 runs at 72 MHz. 25 kHz DDA = 2880 clock ticks per tick; max 12,500 steps/s per axis, i.e. about 156 mm/s at 80 steps/mm. ISR cost is unmeasured.
serial_usb: USART1 PA10/PA9 at 250000 baud, reached through the board's USB-serial chip (CH340 on most 4.2.x) as /dev/ttyUSB0. The direct USART3 option is NOT in this preset.
notes: Compile-only: built in a sandbox with Klipper v0.13.0; never flashed or run on this board by the author.
The stock Creality bootloader flashes a firmware .bin from the SD card on power-up and only accepts a file name it has not flashed before; the tool picks a new skipper-<stamp>.bin each time.
Commonly reported: SD card should be FAT32 and small (32 GB or less); a 4.2.x board usually shows no sign of flashing, so check by connecting afterwards.
UNVERIFIED: some 4.2.x revisions use a GD32F103 or other clone chip; the stock bootloader/offset then may differ. Check your chip marking before flashing.
UNVERIFIED: 4.2.x boards with a non-8 MHz crystal or a different bootloader are not covered.

build_sizes.note: Klipper v0.13.0, arm-none-eabi/avr gcc from Ubuntu apt, sandbox build. RAM = static data+bss only; the segment queue itself is allocated at run time (depth * sizeof(segment): 24 bytes ARM, 23 bytes AVR).

sources: Klipper v0.13.0 config/generic-creality-v4.2.7.cfg and config/printer-creality-ender3-v2-2020.cfg (header comments: STM32F103, 28KiB bootloader, USART1 PA10/PA9, copy out/klipper.bin to SD)
